items.title: Holly Hofmann interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Joe Zawinul wrote plenty of great stuff. [INTERVIEWEE] It doesn’t have to. There are good writers in that idiom.

ctx.x: Joe Zawinul wrote plenty of great stuff.
It doesn’t have to. There are good writers in that idiom. There are some great Sting tunes.
